Edge-case checks passed: id stability preserved on all 3 renumbered personas (ledger-5-reviewer, ledger-6-docs, ledger-7-synthesis); new personas (5-security-auditor, 7-release-engineer) have 170-174 lines of content in both targets; all 4 PM sub-agents (wp-decomposer, dependency-sequencer, pipeline-configurator, ledger-bootstrapper) have 114-156 lines of content.

comments.note: check-known-roles.js outputs 'KNOWN_ROLES and AGENT_ROLES are in sync' but does not print the explicit count (e.g., '9 roles in sync'). No issues found in generated output. All 48 files are clean, complete, and correctly structured. The build system's persona-count-agnostic design handled the 7→9 ledger persona expansion without any script modifications required.

summary: Reviewed all 9 ledger persona output files (vs-code/ and claude-code/) and 15 standalone persona outputs, plus the YAML meta sources, pipeline-maps.ts, constants.ts, and sync/check scripts.

Confirmed: KNOWN_ROLES ↔ AGENT_ROLES parity at 9 roles; PIPELINE_AGENT_MAP correctly routes security-audit → Security Auditor and release-engineering → Release Engineer; all description fields read Step N/9 for positions 1-9; all persona IDs in generated output are present and correct.

No stale pre-renumber files present in any output directory. No unresolved template markers. No security vulnerabilities in generated content or build tooling. PASS.

comments.note: check-known-roles.js success message ('KNOWN_ROLES and AGENT_ROLES are in sync.') omits the explicit role count. This observation has now been raised by Developer, QA, and Reviewer independently — the pattern of triple-flagging suggests it should be addressed in a micro-task rather than deferred indefinitely. A one-line change to add '(9 roles)' to the success message would close this permanently.

PIPELINE_PREREQUISITES, NEXT_AGENT_MAP, and FAIL_ROUTING_MAP in pipeline-maps.ts intentionally omit security-audit and release-engineering (they are legacy static maps for the 4-stage default workflow per the file's JSDoc). This is not a defect, but it is worth confirming that any new WP which activates these stages uses active_pipeline_stages to opt in — the default workflow does not trigger them automatically. Confirmed: the file's comments document this boundary clearly.

8-documentation.md uses vs_file_name: 8-docs.agent.md (not 8-documentation.agent.md). This is intentional ID-stability behaviour — the stable portion 'docs' from the original ledger-6-docs id is preserved in the deployed filename. The pattern is internally consistent but subtle; a note in constraints.md explaining the vs_file_name stability guarantee (separate from id stability) would prevent future confusion when adding or renaming personas.

summary: Audited all active documentation for stale 7-agent references following the v3.8.0 expansion to 9 agents.

Fixed 4 stale references across 3 files: (1) personas/ledger/README.md — updated '1-planner.md … 7-synthesis.md' to '9-synthesis.md' in the Building Personas section; (2) mcp-server/README.md — updated example startup log '7 agents discovered' to '9 agents discovered'; (3) mcp-server/README.md — updated Related Documentation footer 'The 7 agents that use this server' to 'The 9 agents that use this server'; (4) personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md — updated 'do not fit the 7-stage workflow' to '9-stage workflow'.
Confirmed personas/ledger/README.md already reflects the full 9-agent workflow (Stages 1–9, Quick Reference steps 1–10, workflow diagram, and agent flow description). No further gaps found.

Confirmed personas/changelog.md v3.8.0 entry is complete and accurate. Personas manifest (README.md, file-tree.md, constraints.md) already updated in prior work. Historical implementation-history documents left intact — 7-agent references there are accurate period records.

comments.note: The standalone suite description in api-surface.md (now '9-stage workflow') will need to be updated again if the ledger suite ever gains more agents. Consider phrasing it as 'the structured ledger workflow' or similar to avoid another stale count reference in the future.

This is the third independent flag of the check-known-roles.js success message missing the explicit role count. Recommend a micro-task to add '(9 roles)' to the output string — a one-line change with outsized DX benefit.
